# Select

`ui.select` · parts: `Select`, `SelectOption`, `SelectOptGroup` · elements: `<select>`, `<option>`, `<optgroup>`

## Purpose

Select is a native dropdown. Flat options come from the Options list;
SelectOption / SelectOptGroup children cover grouped or custom markup.

## Notes

<!-- ui8kit-docs:prose:start -->
- Flat lists: `options`; grouped lists: `SelectOptGroup` + `SelectOption` children.
- `value` marks the matching option `selected` in markup and drives the live DOM value on the client (React: `value` with `onChange`, else `defaultValue`).
<!-- ui8kit-docs:prose:end -->

## Record types

`SelectOptionItem`: `Value` (string), `Label` (string), `Disabled` (bool)

## Select

Select renders option children from Options, then manual children.

### Props

| Canonical (templ, Jinja2) | React / Solid | HTML (Svelte, Vue, WC) | Type | Default | Kind | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `ID` | `id` | `id` | `string` | — | passthrough attr |  |
| `Name` | `name` | `name` | `string` | — | passthrough attr |  |
| `Value` | `value` | `value` | `string` | — | prop | selected option value |
| `Multiple` | `multiple` | `multiple` | `boolean` | — | prop |  |
| `Required` | `required` | `required` | `boolean` | — | prop |  |
| `Disabled` | `disabled` | `disabled` | `boolean` | — | prop |  |
| `Options` | `options` | `options` | `SelectOptionItem[]` | — | prop |  |
| `AriaInvalid` | `aria-invalid` | `aria-invalid` | `string` | — | passthrough attr |  |
| `AriaDescribedBy` | `aria-describedby` | `aria-describedby` | `string` | — | passthrough attr |  |

Also accepts: `class` (`className` in React), extra attributes (rest props in JS runtimes, `Attrs` in templ/Jinja2, `attrs` in Twig/Latte; caller wins), children.

### Variants

_No variants: the primitive ships no visual classes; style it with token classes via `class`._

### Children

Accepts children (default slot / `children` / `{ children... }` / trusted HTML string in Twig, Latte, Jinja2 — see [runtimes](../runtimes/)). Void tags selected via `tag` render no children.

### ARIA

- Computed/forwarded: `aria-invalid`, `aria-describedby` (omitted when empty).
- Typed ARIA props: `aria-invalid`, `aria-describedby` — static values only.

Compose the part's classes without rendering it (custom root element, no asChild outside React):

| templ | `selectfield.SelectClasses(selectfield.SelectProps{...})` |

| Latte | `\UI8Kit\Latte\Classes::selectClasses(['class' => '…'])` |
| Jinja2 | `select_classes(p)` |

### Usage

Fixture `options` (`{"Name":"c","Value":"b","Options":[{"Value":"a","Label":"A"},{"Value":"b","Label":"B"},{"Value":"c","Label":"C","Disabled":true}]}`) — every snippet renders:

## SelectOption

SelectOption renders a native option.

### Props

| Canonical (templ, Jinja2) | React / Solid | HTML (Svelte, Vue, WC) | Type | Default | Kind | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Value` | `value` | `value` | `string` | — | passthrough attr |  |
| `Selected` | `selected` | `selected` | `boolean` | — | prop |  |
| `Disabled` | `disabled` | `disabled` | `boolean` | — | prop |  |

Also accepts: extra attributes (rest props in JS runtimes, `Attrs` in templ/Jinja2, `attrs` in Twig/Latte; caller wins), children.

### Variants

_No variants: the primitive ships no visual classes; style it with token classes via `class`._

### Children

Accepts children (default slot / `children` / `{ children... }` / trusted HTML string in Twig, Latte, Jinja2 — see [runtimes](../runtimes/)). Void tags selected via `tag` render no children.

### ARIA

- No ARIA attributes are rendered by the primitive; rely on native semantics. Pass extra `aria-*` through attrs.

### Rendered DOM per state

Canonical renderer output (children = `Content`); all 9 runtimes are parity-tested to produce this DOM.

| State | Props | HTML |
| --- | --- | --- |
| defaults | — | `<option>Content</option>` |
| options | `{"Value":"b"}` | `<option value="b">Content</option>` |
| states | `{"Disabled":true}` | `<option disabled>Content</option>` |
| option | `{"Value":"x","Selected":true}` | `<option value="x" selected>Content</option>` |
| group | `{"Disabled":true}` | `<option disabled>Content</option>` |
| Selected | `{"Selected":true}` | `<option selected>Content</option>` |
| Disabled | `{"Disabled":true}` | `<option disabled>Content</option>` |
